pscomppars_cone_10arcmin.query: select pl_name,hostname,tic_id,gaia_dr3_id,ra,dec,disc_year,pl_orbper from pscomppars where ra between 260.70378 and 261.23719 and dec between -51.49087 and -51.15754

pscomppars_by_id.query: select pl_name,hostname,tic_id,gaia_dr3_id from pscomppars where tic_id in ('TIC 214311908','TIC 214311906','TIC 214311910') or gaia_dr3_id like '%5925373272850784768%'

ps_cone_10arcmin.query: select pl_name,hostname,tic_id,default_flag,disc_refname from ps where ra between 260.70378 and 261.23719 and dec between -51.49087 and -51.15754

stellarhosts_cone_10arcmin.query: select sy_name,hostname,tic_id,ra,dec from stellarhosts where ra between 260.70378 and 261.23719 and dec between -51.49087 and -51.15754

toi_by_tid.query: select toi,tid,ra,dec,tfopwg_disp,pl_orbper from toi where tid in (214311908,214311906,214311910,1515709322,1515709367,1515709327)

toi_cone_30arcmin.query: select toi,tid,ra,dec,tfopwg_disp,pl_orbper from toi where ra between 260.17037 and 261.77060 and dec between -51.82420 and -50.82420

toi_table_size.query: select count(*) as n, max(toipfx) as max_toi, max(rowupdate) as last_update from toi

pscomppars_size.query: select count(*) as n from pscomppars
